generationMethod: The catalog retains 24 reviewed public copies originating from historical mixed-mode provider responses and one authenticated first-server snapshot. Provider prompt/source/response hashes and first-attempt limitations identify those historical results. On 2026-10-20 all display copies were manually shortened for readability; this is a human presentation refinement, not a new model response or a claim that all facts were extracted perfectly. Original source text and provider provenance stay unchanged. Raw inputs and first provider responses remain private. The current extraction prompt no longer requests source associations.
limitations: AI can still omit or misclassify facts. Return-vs-leave applicability may overlap; check the original.
Exam schedules may be classified as reminders.
Public examples are privacy-redacted demonstrations; hidden links and contacts cannot be used to sign up. Consult your own original notice.
The selected math response omits audio as a permitted material format; this omission is preserved rather than silently corrected.
Math platform URLs use consistent A/B privacy placeholders to keep the source conflict visible without publishing the URLs.
The selected r17 math output still omits audio as an allowed material; the original and this limitation are retained.
Two selected first responses originally failed the then-current reference contract; free compatibility validation is explicitly distinguished from paid first-response acceptance.

The r21 selected math first response preserves audio as an allowed material and fits one card, but omits the original conflicting Zhihuishu entrypoint warning and the explicit XueTangX 100-point completion statement.
The r21 foreign-language response retains signup and three preliminary submissions in one card; comprehensive-ability and written-translation exam formats are not explicit structured details.
The two r19 quality baselines are not catalog examples: math split into two cards and foreign-language into ten. Their real paid token usage and cost remain counted, with no automatic paid retry.
Current public display wording is manually refined. Historical provider omissions remain distinguished in per-result provenance; the curated display is not raw model output.
